preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 10,000.
The integer k must be between 1 and the length of the string s.
The length of the string s must be a multiple of k.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output must be equal to the number of substrings of length k.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) <= k for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in the output must have a length less than or equal to k.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(line)) == len(line) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in the output must contain unique characters.
